responsibility: Defines the rs6000 subtarget configuration for PowerPC RTEMS ELF systems, including its bi-arch 32/64-bit handling. It adjusts builtins, ABI and code-model policy, startfile/endfile and assembler/link specs, type definitions, TOC/save-restore conventions, and invalid-option checks to match RTEMS expectations while reusing much of the Linux/FreeBSD 64-bit machinery, making it the operating-system integration header for RTEMS on PowerPC.
